caseName: Northwest Airlines, Inc. v. Transport Workers Union
caseNameFull: Northwest Airlines, Inc. v. Transport Workers Union of America, AFL-CIO

opinions.text:
C. A. D. C. Cir. Motion of Chamber of Commerce of the United States for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Certiorari granted and case set for oral argument in tandem with No. 79-972, Westvaco Corp. et al. v. Adams Extract Co. et al., immediately supra.

Mr. Justice Blackmun took no part in the consideration or decision of the motion and petition.
